ui.appcast.share.title: 共享观看
Shared viewing
ui.appcast.share.videoSubtitle: 通过邀请码共享当前投屏；兼容不同 Minecraft 版本
Share a projection by invitation, across Minecraft versions
ui.appcast.share.nativeSubtitle: 共享悬浮字幕 · 原生文字与 3D 动效
Share floating lyrics · native text and 3D animation
ui.appcast.share.relayPlaceholder: 留空使用局域网直连，或填入 TLS 中继地址
Leave blank for LAN direct sharing, or enter a TLS relay address
ui.appcast.share.qualityHint: 默认原生画质与帧率，也可选择 1080p60 或 1080p120。原生模式不主动缩小或限制源帧率，使用高画质压缩；实际帧率受源应用、设备和网络影响。更改画质前请停止共享；双方需要安装 FFmpeg。

Source quality and frame rate is the default. Choose 1080p60 or 1080p120 if preferred. Source mode preserves size and cadence with high-quality compression. Actual FPS depends on the source, hardware and network. Stop sharing before changing quality; both peers need FFmpeg.
ui.appcast.share.nativeHint: 直接同步已显示的歌词、进度、位置、配色和动效，在观看者的游戏内原生渲染，无需视频编码器。
Synchronize displayed lyrics, progress, position, colors and animation, rendered natively in the viewer’s game. No video codec needed.
ui.appcast.share.regenerate: Revoke and create a new code
ui.appcast.share.localPlacement: 在我面前显示（关闭时使用共享者的世界位置）
Show in front of me (otherwise use the sender’s world position)
ui.appcast.share.viewerHint: 默认在共享者所在维度和世界位置显示，请进入同一地点。观众只能观看，不会获得源应用的控制权。
The shared display appears at the sender’s world position in the same dimension. Viewers can watch, without controlling the source application.
ui.appcast.share.privacy: 邀请码包含解密密钥，请只发给允许观看的人。内容端到端加密，邀请码不保存到配置。删除／重新生成会立即断开原有观众；退出世界或关闭功能也会停止共享。

The invitation contains the decryption key; share it only with intended viewers. Content is end-to-end encrypted and invitations are not saved in profiles. Revoking or regenerating disconnects current viewers. Leaving the world or disabling the feature stops sharing.
ui.appcast.share.relayHint: 无需账号或服务器也能直连：留空即可生成局域网邀请码。不同网络需要可达的 IPv6／端口转发，或自建 TLS 中继；中继源码随项目提供。
No account or server is needed for direct LAN sharing: leave the address blank. Across networks, use reachable IPv6 / port forwarding or a self-hosted TLS relay. Relay source is included.
ui.appcast.share.invalidInvite: 邀请码或中继地址无效，请完整复制
Invalid invitation or relay address; copy the complete code
ui.appcast.share.chooseSource: 请先进入世界并选择要共享的投屏来源
Enter a world and choose a projection source first
ui.appcast.share.connectionFailed: 连接已结束或无法连接，请检查地址、证书、网络和邀请码
Connection ended or failed. Check address, certificate, network and invitation
ui.appcast.share.networkSlow: 上传连接超时，已停止共享
ui.appcast.share.codecFailed: 视频编解码失败，请检查 FFmpeg 及显卡驱动
Video codec failed; check FFmpeg and graphics drivers
ui.appcast.share.ffmpegRequired: 共享视频需要 FFmpeg，请安装并加入 PATH 后重启游戏
Video sharing needs FFmpeg on PATH. Install it and restart the game
ui.appcast.share.wrongType: 邀请码类型不匹配，请在对应的投屏或字幕页面加入
Wrong invitation type; join through the matching projection or lyrics page
ui.appcast.share.showInvite: 显示邀请码（请勿在录屏时公开）
Show invitation (keep it private when recording)
